thread.title: Digitimes Analyst Puts Light on Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s 4 Next Generation iPhone Projects

author: Douglas Bein
title: Digitimes Analyst Puts Light on Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s 4 Next Generation iPhone Projects
text:
January 29, 2018 Digitimes Analyst Puts Light on Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s 4 Next Generation iPhone Projects 
According to Digitimes Research senior analyst, Luke Lin Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has been working to develop next-generation iPhone projects, and there are 4 iPhone: a 5.7- to 5.8-inch LCD device; a 6.0- to 6.1-inch LCD device; a 6.0- to 6.1-inch OLED device; and a 6.4- to 6.5-inch OLED device respectively. 
But as per the Digitimes sources, the vendor is likely to launch the two LCD phones and the 6.4- to 6.5-inch OLED one suddenly. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s next-generation iPhone line-up is same to the portfolio it had launched last year, the two LCD panel-based devices, exactly like the iPhone 8 and iPhone 8 Plus and the OLED-based iPhone X. 
Apple originally intended to push the two OLED iPhones and the 6.0- to 6.1-inch LCD iPhone, but has recently started leaning toward the combination of the two LCD models plus the 6.4- to 6.5-inch OLED iPhone, abandoning the 6.0- to 6.1-inch OLED model. 
Lin said, these four projects by the company, all support wireless charging and 3D, and also the sensing functionalities, 
The tech company has not yet made the final decision, so far, there is a possibility that the vendor may come up with another combination, Lin added. 
Apple Inc. (AAPL) is preparing a new inexpensive smartphone, for the entry-level sector that resembles to the iPhone SE for 2018 and also featuring the wireless charging functionality, but not the 3D sensing. Most expectedly, in the second quarter, will begin the mass production of smartphone with the official launch in May or June, Lin noted.
